faculty.name: Gary Bente
faculty.summary: Studies nonverbal communication, media effects, and avatar-based virtual reality, using psychophysiology, eye tracking, and continuous response measurement.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非语言传播、媒介效果与基于虚拟化身的虚拟现实，采用心理生理测量、眼动追踪与连续反应测量。

faculty.name: Daniel E. Bergan
faculty.summary: Studies public opinion, advocacy campaigns, and partisan polarization, using field experiments that test how citizen contacts influence policymakers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究舆论、倡导运动与党派极化，通过田野实验检验公民联络如何影响政策制定者。

faculty.name: Dustin Carnahan
faculty.summary: Studies how citizens engage with political information, how misperceptions form, and how fact-checks and corrections counter misinformation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公民如何接触政治信息、错误认知如何形成，以及事实核查与更正信息如何应对虚假信息。

faculty.name: James W. Dearing
faculty.summary: Studies the diffusion of innovations and the dissemination and implementation of evidence-based practices in public health, healthcare, and environmental programs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创新扩散，以及循证实践在公共卫生、医疗与环境项目中的传播与实施。

faculty.name: William A. Donohue
faculty.summary: Studies communication in conflict, negotiation, and mediation, with attention to how framing shapes negotiation processes and leadership development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究冲突、谈判与调解中的传播，关注框架如何影响谈判过程以及领导力发展。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Dorrance Hall
faculty.summary: Studies communication in families and close relationships, including difficult conversations, family marginalization, and support for first-generation and STEM-interested youth.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究家庭与亲密关系中的传播，包括艰难对话、家庭边缘化，以及对第一代大学生和对STEM感兴趣青年的支持。

faculty.name: Allison Eden
faculty.summary: Studies media enjoyment and entertainment, examining how enjoyment drives attention and media selection and how entertainment affects well-being and morality.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介享受与娱乐，考察享受如何驱动注意与媒介选择，以及娱乐如何影响幸福感与道德。

faculty.name: Jacob Fisher
faculty.summary: Studies attention and decision-making in digital media and moral messaging, using functional neuroimaging, big behavioral data, and computational and network modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字媒介中的注意与决策以及道德信息，采用功能性神经影像、大规模行为数据以及计算与网络建模。

faculty.name: Amanda Holmstrom
faculty.summary: Studies supportive communication and social support messages in relationships and their links to physical, mental, and relational well-being.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际关系中的支持性传播与社会支持信息，及其与身心和关系福祉的关联。

faculty.name: Maria Lapinski
faculty.summary: Studies how persuasive messages and social norms shape health and environmental risk behaviors, with attention to cultural dynamics in projects across many countries.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究说服信息与社会规范如何影响健康与环境风险行为，关注文化动态，项目覆盖多个国家。

faculty.name: David Markowitz
faculty.summary: Studies how language patterns reveal social and psychological processes such as deception, persuasion, and bias, using computational text analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言模式如何揭示欺骗、说服与偏见等社会心理过程，采用计算文本分析方法。

faculty.name: Vernon Miller
faculty.summary: Studies communication in organizations, including employment interviews, newcomer entry and socialization, role negotiation, and organizational change.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究组织中的传播，包括招聘面试、新员工进入与社会化、角色协商以及组织变革。

faculty.name: Yoo Jung (Erika) Oh
faculty.summary: Studies human-AI communication with chatbots, examining how persuasive AI shapes perceptions, relationships, and health behavior change.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人与AI聊天机器人的传播，考察具说服力的AI如何影响人的认知、关系与健康行为改变。

faculty.name: Tai-Quan "Winson" Peng
faculty.summary: Studies how successive communication technologies, from the internet to AI, shape attention, interpretation, and influence, using computational social science methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究从互联网到AI的历代传播技术如何影响注意、解读与影响过程，采用计算社会科学方法。

faculty.name: Ralf Schmälzle
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes persuasive health and media messages, using fMRI, EEG, computational modeling, and VR/AI environments alongside behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何加工健康与媒介说服信息，结合fMRI、EEG、计算建模与VR/AI环境以及行为实验。

faculty.name: John L. Sherry
faculty.summary: Studies educational video games and communication as a complex dynamic system, using modeling, simulation, and experiments on learning during play.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究教育类电子游戏以及作为复杂动态系统的传播，采用建模、仿真以及关于游戏中学习的实验。

faculty.name: Stephen Spates
faculty.summary: Studies how communication organizes and constructs identity, focusing on bias, discrimination, and social identity in organizations and on AI for communication skills.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究传播如何组织与建构身份，关注组织中的偏见、歧视与社会身份，以及利用AI提升沟通技能。

faculty.name: Ron Tamborini
faculty.summary: Studies how media technology characteristics shape psychological experience, including moral intuition, natural mapping in video games, and media enjoyment and appreciation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介技术特征如何塑造心理体验，包括道德直觉、电子游戏中的自然映射以及媒介享受与欣赏。

faculty.name: Monique Turner
faculty.summary: Studies persuasion and the role of emotions like guilt, anger, and fear in message design and processing for health, risk, and political communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究说服以及内疚、愤怒、恐惧等情绪在健康、风险与政治传播信息设计与加工中的作用。

faculty.name: Brandon Van Der Heide
faculty.summary: Studies computer-mediated and interpersonal communication, focusing on how online cues shape impressions, credibility, and influence in reviews and social media.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究计算机中介传播与人际传播，关注网络线索如何影响在线评论与社交媒体中的印象、可信度与影响力。

faculty.name: Brooke Wolfe
faculty.summary: Studies how people communicate when coping with acute and chronic stressors across the lifespan in interpersonal, family, and health contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们在应对急性与慢性压力时如何沟通，涵盖整个生命历程中的人际、家庭与健康情境。

faculty.name: Danielle K. Brown
faculty.summary: Studies media representations, narrative change, social movements, and race and identity, and leads community-engaged work against misinformation via trusted messengers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介再现、叙事变革、社会运动与种族身份，并主持借助可信信使应对虚假信息的社区参与式项目。

faculty.name: Manuel (Manny) Chavez
faculty.summary: Studies sociology of the news media, media law, crisis reporting, disinformation, and access to information and press systems, especially in Ibero-America.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新闻媒体社会学、媒介法、危机报道、虚假信息以及信息获取与新闻体制，尤其关注伊比利亚美洲。

faculty.name: Eric Freedman
faculty.summary: Teaches and practices environmental journalism, directing the Knight Center for Environmental Journalism, and has taught and trained journalists in post-Soviet countries, including Central Asia.
faculty.summary_zh: 讲授并从事环境新闻实践，主持奈特环境新闻中心，并在中亚等后苏联国家开展国际新闻教学与培训。

faculty.name: Muhammad Ittefaq
faculty.summary: Studies global news coverage of health and environmental issues, science misinformation, AI's impacts, and how publics interpret climate and science messages.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究全球健康与环境议题的新闻报道、科学虚假信息、AI的影响，以及公众如何解读气候与科学信息。

faculty.name: Serena Miller
faculty.summary: Studies social science theory building, concept explication, scale development, and metascience, along with alternative journalism and non-scientific ways of knowing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会科学理论建构、概念阐释、量表开发与元科学，以及另类新闻与非科学的认知方式。

faculty.name: Christina L. Myers
faculty.summary: Studies depictions of Black experiences and implicit racial bias in news, music, and sports media, using qualitative methods and Critical Race Theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用质性方法与批判种族理论，研究新闻、音乐与体育媒体中的黑人经验呈现及隐性种族偏见。

faculty.name: Perry Parks
faculty.summary: Studies how taken-for-granted news norms and values limit journalism, using historical, critical, and discourse analysis, including in science journalism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究习以为常的新闻规范与价值如何限制新闻业，采用历史、批判与话语分析，也涉及科学新闻。

faculty.name: Swarnavel Eswaran Pillai
faculty.summary: Studies the history, theory, and production of documentary and Tamil cinema, including its ties to Hollywood and Hindi film and questions of caste and gender.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究纪录片与泰米尔电影的历史、理论与制作，包括其与好莱坞及印地语电影的关系以及种姓与性别议题。

faculty.name: Bruno Takahashi
faculty.summary: Studies news coverage of environmental issues and environmental journalism practices in Latin America and U.S. Latino media, plus identity in science communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境议题的新闻报道，以及拉丁美洲与美国拉丁裔媒体的环境新闻实践，并关注科学传播中的身份问题。

faculty.name: Tim P. Vos
faculty.summary: Studies journalistic roles, gatekeeping, and media sociology, along with media history and media policy across print, broadcast, and digital news.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新闻从业者角色、把关与媒介社会学，以及纸媒、广电与数字新闻的媒介史与媒介政策。

faculty.name: Geri Alumit Zeldes
faculty.summary: Studies news coverage of race, ethnicity, and religion and produces documentary films that tell stories from the margins.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究有关种族、族裔与宗教的新闻报道，并制作讲述边缘群体故事的纪录片。

faculty.name: Fashina Aladé
faculty.summary: Studies how young children comprehend and learn from educational media and technology, often in partnership with children's media producers and community groups.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究幼儿如何理解并从教育媒介与技术中学习，常与儿童媒体制作方及社区组织合作。

faculty.name: Saleem E. Alhabash
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and emotional effects of social media in persuasion, including alcohol marketing, digital aggression, online counterfeits, and attitudes toward nations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社交媒体在说服中的认知与情绪效果，包括酒类营销、网络攻击、网购假货以及对他国的态度。

faculty.name: John C. Besley
faculty.summary: Studies public views of science and scientists' views of communication, including trust and fairness perceptions, through large surveys and interviews of scientists.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公众对科学的看法与科学家对传播的看法，包括信任与公平感，采用大规模调查与科学家访谈。

faculty.name: Matea Čaluk
faculty.summary: Studies how executive leaders make decisions during crisis and uncertainty and how identity shapes those decisions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高层领导者在危机与不确定时期如何决策，以及身份如何影响其决策。

faculty.name: Luke Capizzo
faculty.summary: Studies public relations and social issues management, including activism, dialogue, organizational listening, sustainability, and PR pedagogy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公共关系与社会议题管理，包括行动主义、对话、组织倾听、可持续发展与公关教育。

faculty.name: Chuqing Dong
faculty.summary: Studies CSR and ESG communication, nonprofit-corporate alliances, government communication, and AI in public relations, using multimethod designs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任与ESG传播、非营利组织与企业联盟、政府传播以及公关中的AI，采用多方法设计。

faculty.name: Kelly Gaggin
faculty.summary: Studies public relations and strategic communication as drivers of cross-cultural understanding and relationship-building, especially for nonprofit organizations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公共关系与战略传播如何促进跨文化理解与关系建立，尤其关注非营利组织。

faculty.name: Dan Hiaeshutter-Rice
faculty.summary: Studies how communication technologies and identity shape political, health, and environmental information in the U.S., using computational methods, surveys, and experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究传播技术与身份如何塑造美国的政治、健康与环境信息，采用计算方法、调查与实验。

faculty.name: Bree E. Holtz
faculty.summary: Studies adoption and outcomes of telemedicine, mHealth apps, wearable sensors, and AI in healthcare, using mixed methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究远程医疗、移动健康应用、可穿戴传感器与医疗AI的采纳及其效果，采用混合方法。

faculty.name: Patricia T. Huddleston
faculty.summary: Studies consumer information processing of retail point-of-purchase displays, using eye tracking to link signage and price cues to purchase intention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究消费者对零售终端陈列的信息加工，利用眼动追踪考察标识与价格线索对购买意向的影响。

faculty.name: Anastasia Kononova
faculty.summary: Studies media multitasking across cultures and the lifespan and its effects on cognition, emotion, and resistance to advertising and health messages.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究跨文化与跨生命周期的媒介多任务行为，及其对认知、情绪以及对广告与健康信息抵抗的影响。

faculty.name: Hairong Li
faculty.summary: Studies the uses, effects, and implications of digital technology, including interactive media, AI, and big data, in advertising and marketing communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字技术（包括互动媒介、AI与大数据）在广告与营销传播中的使用、效果与影响。

faculty.name: Mengyan Ma
faculty.summary: Studies how influencers, family communication, and AI shape health behaviors and well-being among youth and families, using mixed and community-engaged methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究网红、家庭沟通与AI如何影响青少年与家庭的健康行为与幸福感，采用混合方法与社区参与式研究。

faculty.name: Anna R McAlister
faculty.summary: Studies children's consumer behavior, applying developmental psychology to children's knowledge of food brands, responses to food advertising, and food preferences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童消费行为，运用发展心理学考察儿童对食品品牌的认知、对食品广告的反应及食物偏好形成。

faculty.name: Susan McFarlane-Alvarez
faculty.summary: Studies how historical, cultural, and ideological forces shape identity and image representations in advertising and strategic communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究历史、文化与意识形态力量如何塑造广告与战略传播中的身份与影像再现。

faculty.name: Dar Meshi
faculty.summary: Studies the psychology and neuroscience of technology use, including problematic social media use in adults and adolescents and the use of blockchain web3 apps.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究技术使用的心理与神经机制，包括成人与青少年的问题性社交媒体使用以及区块链web3应用的使用。

faculty.name: Maria D. Molina
faculty.summary: Studies how technological affordances shape online persuasion in digital health, misinformation sharing, and privacy decisions with generative AI chatbots.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究技术可供性如何影响数字健康、虚假信息分享以及与生成式AI聊天机器人互动时隐私决策中的网络说服。

faculty.name: Juan Mundel
faculty.summary: Studies effects of marketing and social media advertising on underserved and at-risk groups, such as anxiety, addiction, and intent to buy alcohol or e-cigarettes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究营销与社交媒体广告对弱势和高风险群体的影响，如焦虑、成瘾以及购买酒类或电子烟的意向。

faculty.name: Hannah Overbye-Thompson
faculty.summary: Studies how people detect bias and limitations in AI and algorithmic systems and how they adapt their technology use in response.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何察觉AI与算法系统中的偏见与局限，以及如何相应调整其技术使用。

faculty.name: Nancy Rhodes
faculty.summary: Studies persuasion and social influence, especially how social norms affect message processing and health risk behaviors like smoking, drinking, and risky driving.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究说服与社会影响，尤其是社会规范如何影响信息加工以及吸烟、饮酒、危险驾驶等健康风险行为。

faculty.name: Edward Timke
faculty.summary: Studies the cultural history of advertising and disability innovation and accessibility in North America and Europe, using oral history, ethnography, and archives.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究广告文化史以及北美与欧洲的残障创新与无障碍实践，采用口述史、民族志与档案研究。

faculty.name: Aileen Torrance
faculty.summary: Holds a faculty post in advertising and public relations; the department profile gives no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于广告与公共关系系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Mariah Wellman
faculty.summary: Studies social media influencers and wellness culture, including how wellness creators build authority, plus social media use in patient-provider health communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社交媒体网红与健康养生文化，包括养生创作者如何建立权威，以及社交媒体在医患健康沟通中的作用。

faculty.name: Maral Zakharia
faculty.summary: Holds a faculty post in advertising and public relations; the department profile gives no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于广告与公共关系系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Young Anna Argyris
faculty.summary: Studies health misinformation and social media influence, building deep learning models to classify vaccine misinformation and designing counter-campaigns.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康虚假信息与社交媒体影响力，构建深度学习模型识别疫苗虚假信息并设计反制传播活动。

faculty.name: Johannes M. Bauer
faculty.summary: Studies the digital economy and the governance and policy of information and communication technologies, with international and comparative scope.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字经济以及信息通信技术的治理与政策，具有国际与比较视野。

faculty.name: Susan Bonner
faculty.summary: Designs and studies entertainment and serious games, including AR games, to transform healthcare and teach children social-emotional coping skills.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计并研究娱乐与严肃游戏（包括AR游戏），用于变革医疗以及教授儿童社会情绪应对技能。

faculty.name: Sandra Braman
faculty.summary: Studies the macro-level effects of digital technologies and information policy, analyzing U.S. statutes and constitutional law on falsity, disinformation, and AI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字技术的宏观影响与信息政策，分析美国有关虚假陈述、虚假信息与AI的法规与宪法。

faculty.name: Celeste Campos-Castillo
faculty.summary: Studies how technologies like chatbots and health tools can be designed to reduce health inequalities, using multimethod, community-partnered research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究如何设计聊天机器人与健康工具等技术以缓解健康不平等，采用多方法、与社区合作的研究。

faculty.name: Amanda Cote
faculty.summary: Studies the game industry and gaming culture, including gender and identity, developer labor and crunch, and collegiate esports, through interviews and discourse analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究游戏产业与游戏文化，包括性别与身份、开发者劳动与加班文化以及大学电竞，采用访谈与话语分析。

faculty.name: David Ewoldsen
faculty.summary: Studies media psychology, including comprehension of media messages, racism and the media, cooperative video game play, and attitudes in risky health behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介心理学，包括媒介信息理解、种族主义与媒介、合作类电子游戏以及态度在健康风险行为中的作用。

faculty.name: Keith Hampton
faculty.summary: Studies how digital technologies and social networks shape community, well-being, adolescent mental health, social isolation, and willingness to voice opinions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字技术与社会网络如何影响社区、幸福感、青少年心理健康、社会孤立以及表达意见的意愿。

faculty.name: Jean Hardy
faculty.summary: Studies the role of technology in rural economic and community development, broadband policy, and collaborative technologies among rural LGBTQ people, drawing on CSCW and STS.
faculty.summary_zh: 借鉴CSCW与STS研究技术在乡村经济与社区发展中的作用、宽带政策，以及乡村LGBTQ群体的协作技术。

faculty.name: Megan Knittel
faculty.summary: Studies tech harms, cybersafety, digital equity, and platform governance, using mixed methods in settings such as domestic violence and rural Michigan communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究技术伤害、网络安全、数字公平与平台治理，在家庭暴力与密歇根乡村社区等情境中采用混合方法。

faculty.name: Hee Rin Lee
faculty.summary: Designs and evaluates social robots for social good, aiming to empower marginalized groups such as low-income people and older adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计并评估面向社会公益的社交机器人，旨在赋权低收入人群与老年人等边缘群体。

faculty.name: Sian Lee
faculty.summary: Studies how information environments and generative AI shape beliefs and decisions, covering misinformation, sport analytics, and LLM alignment, using machine learning and statistics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究信息环境与生成式AI如何影响信念与决策，涵盖虚假信息、体育数据分析与大模型对齐，采用机器学习与统计方法。

faculty.name: Megh Marathe
faculty.summary: Studies inclusion in medical and civic expert practices and technologies, such as epilepsy care, brain implants, and gender-diverse data, through ethnography.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过民族志研究医疗与公民领域专家实践与技术中的包容性，如癫痫诊疗、脑植入设备与性别多元数据。

faculty.name: Casey O'Donnell
faculty.summary: Studies the creative collaborative work and culture of videogame design and development in AAA studios and independent communities, and develops games.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究3A工作室与独立开发社区中电子游戏设计与开发的创意协作及其文化，并亲自开发游戏。

faculty.name: Jennifer Olson
faculty.summary: Studies climate and land-use change impacts in Africa and runs ICT-for-development projects that co-design technologies with farmers and youth.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲气候与土地利用变化的影响，并开展与农民和青少年共同设计技术的信息通信技术促进发展项目。

faculty.name: Wei Peng
faculty.summary: Studies psychological mechanisms of behavior change and designs and evaluates chatbots, exergames, and mobile apps for health promotion.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为改变的心理机制，并设计与评估用于健康促进的聊天机器人、运动游戏与移动应用。

faculty.name: Daniel Putman
faculty.summary: Studies how social networks and digital technology shape vulnerability, resilience, and responses to risk among the poor, using applied microeconomics and computational social science.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用应用微观经济学与计算社会科学，研究社会网络与数字技术如何影响贫困人群的脆弱性、韧性与风险应对。

faculty.name: Rabindra Ratan
faculty.summary: Studies psychological effects of human-technology interaction such as avatars, VR/XR, video games, and AI, including the Proteus effect and gender stereotypes in gaming.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人机交互的心理效应，涉及虚拟化身、VR/XR、电子游戏与AI，包括普罗透斯效应与游戏中的性别刻板印象。

faculty.name: Ruth Shillair
faculty.summary: Studies how communication strategies and policy can improve cybersecurity practices, increase digital literacy, and reduce the digital divide.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究如何通过传播策略与政策改善网络安全实践、提升数字素养并缩小数字鸿沟。

faculty.name: Michael Stern
faculty.summary: Studies health information seeking and digital inequality among marginalized and rural groups, and advances survey methodology using web, mobile, and big data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究边缘化与乡村群体的健康信息寻求与数字不平等，并利用网络、移动与大数据推进调查方法。

faculty.name: Morgan Vigil-Hayes
faculty.summary: Studies how rural and Indigenous communities build and govern networked information systems, and designs and deploys community-owned networks with tribal partners.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究乡村与原住民社区如何建设和治理网络信息系统，并与部落伙伴设计部署社区自有网络。

faculty.name: Brian Winn
faculty.summary: Designs, creates, and studies interactive media, including game design, digital game-based learning, and interactive health communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计、制作并研究互动媒介，包括游戏设计、数字游戏化学习与互动健康传播。

faculty.name: Susan Wyche
faculty.summary: Studies technology use in Sub-Saharan Africa for HCI and ICT-for-development, grounded in long-term fieldwork at Kenyan sites.
faculty.summary_zh: 基于在肯尼亚的长期田野调查，研究撒哈拉以南非洲的技术使用，服务于人机交互与信息通信技术促进发展领域。

faculty.name: Lucinda D. Davenport
faculty.summary: Journalism studies scholar working on digital media technologies in journalism, media history, journalism education, ethics, and women and media, including news source diversity tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 新闻学研究者，关注新闻业中的数字媒体技术、媒介史、新闻教育、新闻伦理及女性与媒介，并开发新闻信源多样性工具。
